research_direction: The signs-of-life question (seeded direction 3), asked on the MIDTRAIN stage before any SFT, where the order-symmetric readout from #293 is not saturated (answer bias 0.39-0.49 nats vs 1.4-8.4 after SFT). Two complete 2x2 grids differing only in planted-document dose, 5% vs 25%. Content preference vs each grid's own token-matched clean control: +0.011 at 5%, +0.000 at 25%. No dose-response, and not a no-op recipe -- at 25% the live midtrain's loss falls 0.591 nats against the clean control's 0.021 over 323 optimizer updates. The documents were fit; the behaviour did not move. At 1B on this corpus, fitting is not installing.
submitted_cells: The 25%-dose grid (#263's cells), SFT seed 20260804, published for this PR as arcadia-impact/revdose25-1b-{R,M,S,T}. Cell R is a real trained cell (clean Dolmino midtrain -> clean SFT, 324 + 631 optimizer updates), not the base model.
relationship_to_prior_attempts: Re-reads #263's 25%-dose checkpoints with the readout built in #293, and contrasts them against #272/#291's 5%-dose grid. Nothing was retrained. #291's 7-seed distribution (SD ~0.2) is why no weight is placed on the single-seed interaction rows here.
what_still_replicates: The null is the claim: no detectable midtrain install at either dose, with loss-curve evidence that the stage fit its documents. The SFT stage moves the same quantity by +0.234 to +0.258 in the same grids.
